record.title: Select the first RF question and draft the arrival protocol
record.intent: Convert known capabilities and source limits into a falsifiable bounded experiment proposal.
requirements: Follow docs/research/rf-response-roadmap.md and reconcile the dated RF evaluation plan without rewriting prior physical evidence. Select relative policy-effect comparison, corrected absolute response, or an explicit staged combination.

Draft falsifiable hypotheses, matched settings and path, software arms, frequencies, reference point, repeats, estimator, drift witnesses, decision sensitivity and claim limits. Distinguish no detected improvement from failed controls.

Draft source accession, connection/level budget, warm-up, waveform export, capture, stop/recovery and final-state procedures. Identify exact arrival unknowns and required operator-authorized physical transitions.
Record remaining bench facts and timing assumptions. If B or C contracts need changes, revise through taskctl with expected revision and currency reconciliation; preserve the prior proposal.
Commit and push the phase-A conclusion and any revised tasking before physical preparation. Closing this task does not authorize RF or instrument operations.
acceptance: A reviewable provisional protocol and evidence-based phase-A disposition identify the smallest arrival/integration work and its conditions.
